vb_textbox.text: The gnome it is best to pick tends to switch now and again. They tend to be in pairs - for example, the purple and pink gnome will be bets to pick at the same time, then when it changes it will be thew green and brown. It can be hard to tell when to switch, but I would check the other gnome when the gnome I've been picking gives 3 or less mushrooms.
